Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryBlendBatch

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryBlendBatch
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryBlendBatch extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable source receipts for a mass-basis refinery blend batch.

A normalized source recipe is scaled to one positive batch mass. Source liquid volumes use the same ideal-additive-volume and 60 degrees Fahrenheit water-density basis as RefineryAssayBlend. The result is bookkeeping evidence only; it does not model temperature correction, blend contraction, tank gauging, phase behavior, or compatibility.

  • Method Details

    • fromMassFractions

      public static RefineryBlendBatch fromMassFractions(double totalMassKg, double[] sourceMassFractions, double[] sourceSpecificGravities)
      Scale one normalized source recipe to an auditable batch receipt.
      Parameters:
      totalMassKg - requested positive total batch mass in kg
      sourceMassFractions - non-negative source mass fractions summing to one
      sourceSpecificGravities - source specific gravities on the 60 degrees Fahrenheit basis
      Returns:
      immutable uncosted batch receipt
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid mass, arrays, fractions, or contributing source gravities

    • fromOptimization

      public static RefineryBlendBatch fromOptimization(double totalMassKg, RefineryLinearBlendOptimizer.Result optimization, double[] sourceSpecificGravities)
      Scale a qualified minimum-cost optimization result to an auditable batch receipt.
      Parameters:
      totalMassKg - requested positive total batch mass in kg
      optimization - qualified refinery linear-blend result
      sourceSpecificGravities - source specific gravities in optimization source order
      Returns:
      immutable costed batch receipt
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if optimization is null
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid mass, arrays, fractions, gravities, or cost
